task_title: doctor/validate drift errors should print the remediation command
task_criteria: The boardctl CLI's doctor and validate commands, when they report header-counter drift (ticks_total < max events tick_number), must print an actionable remediation hint naming the fixing command (e.g. boardctl header --set-ticks-total=N) right after the error line. Add at least one regression test asserting the hint text appears for a drifted board. go build ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./... -count=1 -short all pass.
